title: Blackbox: Core Loop
summary: Collect fragments carefully, read the consequences, and act only when the pattern is clear.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Find a fragment, identify its context, follow the smallest safe lead, and reassess. The best Blackbox progress is deliberate and logged.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each fragment, compare the directive against your current route and supplies. A strange clue is useful only when you can survive acting on it.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Pause when the next directive feels vague or expensive. Bank the record, mark the site, and return with the right tools.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
